user.title: NSW Trains
user.description: What would you like to add?

station_search.title: Find a station
station_search.description: Get a free API key from the [Transport for NSW Open Data Hub](https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/), with access to the Trip Planner and Realtime APIs.

line.title: Line status
line.description: On-time running, delays, alerts and trackwork for a line. Get a free API key from the [Transport for NSW Open Data Hub](https://opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au/).

home.title: Trains passing home
home.description: Predicts when trains pass a point on the line, and tracks the nearest train by GPS. Defaults to your Home Assistant home location.

home_stations.title: Stations either side
home_stations.description: Choose the stations on either side of the location, so that trains stopping at both pass it. The two nearest are suggested.

reauth_confirm.title: Update API key
reauth_confirm.description: Transport for NSW rejected the API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Transport for NSW API
error.no_stations: No train or metro stations match that name
error.no_nearby_stations: Fewer than two train stations within 8 km of that location

data_description.platform: Platform number, e.g. 16. Leave blank for all platforms.

data_description.passing_radius: Turn on 'Train passing' when a train's live GPS position is this close. Predicted pass times also turn it on.
